features.headline: Continuous scroll or one page at a time
features.description: Read long PDFs in a smooth vertical scrolling column or focus on a single page at a time, with high-DPI PDF.js rendering, sidebar thumbnails, and bookmarks.
bullets: Switch between continuous vertical scroll and single-page view (Ctrl+Shift+M), remembered across sessions.
Lazy-rendered page column keeps memory bounded by only holding pages near your reading line.
Turn pages naturally with the mouse wheel, Space/Shift+Space, PageUp/PageDown, or arrow keys.
Zoom in/out, fit page, fit width, rotate in 90° steps, full-screen mode, and dark/light themes.
Sidebar with lazily rendered page thumbnails, collapsible document outline (bookmarks), and recent files.
features.screenshotAlt: Cambuz PDF Reader open on a multi-page PDF with page thumbnails sidebar and reading toolbar
features.screenshotCaption: High-DPI PDF rendering with continuous scroll, single-page view, thumbnails, and document outline.

features.headline: Fast full-document search with on-page highlights
features.description: Find words and phrases across the entire PDF with instant next/previous navigation, match counts, and cached repeat queries.
bullets: Full-document substring search with on-page highlights and next/previous wrapping across pages.
Case-insensitive by default with an instant case-sensitive (Aa) toggle.
Unicode NFC-normalized matching across English, Indic scripts, and right-to-left text runs.
In-memory extracted-text LRU cache makes repeat searches across 100-page documents near-instant.
features.screenshotAlt: Full-document search bar highlighting matches on a PDF page in Cambuz PDF Reader
features.screenshotCaption: Search across every page with live match counts, on-page highlights, and case-sensitive matching.

features.headline: Accurate text selection, copy, forms, and page tools
features.description: Select and copy text cleanly through the PDF.js text layer, fill and save AcroForm documents, and reorganize pages on a safe working copy.
bullets: Mouse drag selection, Ctrl+A on the current page, and Ctrl+C copy to the system clipboard.
Fillable AcroForm fields (text, checkboxes, radio groups, dropdowns, list boxes) saved to a new file with rebuilt appearance streams.
Page tools on an in-memory working copy: rotate, delete, extract, reorder, merge, split, and edit metadata with up to 20 undo steps.
Honours document copy-restriction flags and opens password-protected PDFs in memory without storing passwords.
features.screenshotAlt: Selecting and copying text and filling interactive PDF form fields in Cambuz PDF Reader
features.screenshotCaption: Clean text selection and copy, interactive AcroForm filling, and non-destructive page tools.

features.headline: Prepare once, then print with your system PDF viewer
features.description: Preview and save the exact print-ready PDF, then explicitly open it in your registered PDF viewer for printer and driver settings.
bullets: Live preview rendered from the exact prepared PDF artifact.
Current, all, or selected pages; portrait/landscape and A4, A3, A5, Letter, Legal, and Tabloid paper sizes.
Five margin presets plus custom margins (0–50 mm), fit/actual/custom scaling, and 2-up or 4-up sheets.
Independent print-ready PDF download, explicit system-viewer handoff, and optional 200 dpi grayscale Ink Saver mode.
features.screenshotAlt: Cambuz PDF Reader preparation dialog with page range, layout, Ink Saver, export, and system-viewer controls
features.screenshotCaption: Cambuz previews the exact prepared artifact; the system PDF viewer controls printer selection, copies, duplex, and cancellation.

features.headline: Hindi, Punjabi, and 11 more scripts — plus optional local OCR
features.description: Verified across a 13-language test matrix for rendering, search, and Unicode clipboard copy, with optional offline Tesseract OCR for scanned pages.
bullets: 13-language test matrix covering English, Hindi (Devanagari), Punjabi (Gurmukhi), Bengali, Gujarati, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, Malayalam, Odia, Assamese, Marathi, and RTL Urdu.
Preserves conjuncts, combining marks, and Unicode text on the system clipboard when the PDF encodes valid font mappings.
Explicit on-demand local OCR for scanned pages via a user-installed Tesseract 4+ engine (up to 3 languages per run, never automatic, zero uploads).
features.screenshotAlt: Rendering and searching Hindi and Punjabi Unicode PDF documents in Cambuz PDF Reader
features.screenshotCaption: Verified rendering, full-text search, and Unicode clipboard copy across 13 languages.

features.headline: Offline, private by design, and built for the desktop
features.description: A hardened Electron desktop app with zero network requests, no telemetry, no accounts, and native builds for Windows, Linux, and macOS.
bullets: Works 100% offline after download — no telemetry, analytics, crash reporting, accounts, or background auto-updaters.
Hardened Electron shell with sandboxed renderer, context isolation, no Node integration, and strict navigation policies.
Windows 10/11 x64 NSIS installer (per-user, Start Menu shortcut, .pdf association) and single-file portable executable.
Experimental Linux x64 AppImage and macOS 13+ Apple Silicon DMG/ZIP builds verified in CI.
features.screenshotAlt: Cambuz PDF Reader running as a native desktop application
features.screenshotCaption: Lightweight offline desktop PDF reader with per-user Windows installer, portable EXE, Linux AppImage, and macOS builds.
